title: HarnessDeclaration
description: What a harness declares about itself to the platform. One file per harness at harness/<name>/harness.yaml. The gateway declaration is mandatory: the platform ships no universal gateway, so every harness must state how its agents are reached for model connectivity — natively (the harness ships its own), through an external service, or not at all. Descriptive and validated, never a second configuration language.

name.description: The harness's registry name — must match its directory under harness/ and the runtime key the CLI dispatches on.

status.description: frozen-legacy: works, gains nothing; see the harness's README for the freeze terms.

kind.description: native: the harness ships its own gateway. external-service: model connectivity resolves through a named external gateway. none: the harness makes no model connections.

notes.description: How selection/config flows through it — prose, for the reader.
